name: tactical-start-second-turn
description: Playtest 8, pbd469 round 3 (HIGH): Mentak's 2nd turn could not start a tactical action — the turn panel said 'click a system on the map' but nothing lit. Bot side was right: the turn menu (Tactical Action (9) / Component / Play Warfare) and its turn.action decision with a live tactical option were posted, active system empty. The trigger: Naalu's Imperial primary ('Score A Public') posted its 'Please score objectives.' prompt (FFCC_naalu_po_scoring_*) in the actions channel AFTER Mentak's turn menu, and it stays up; the web's pending-prompt scan drops a faction prompt older than another player's newer prompt, so the map saw no turn step. pbd469@298 (Naalu just ended turn, Mentak active) with Naalu's Imperial card re-posted; Mentak's turn menu posted (/player turn_start); then Naalu presses Score A Public as the autopilot did. Expect Mentak's start-of-turn menu still open with a live tactical option (the web now takes that decision as the map's turn step), no active system, and Naalu's leftover scoring prompt open after it.
